name: *arr Suite
hook: Automate your media library — Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr.
bullets: Sonarr (TV), Radarr (Movies), Lidarr (Music), Readarr (Books) — auto-download and organize
Prowlarr manages all your indexers in one place — 500+ torrent trackers and Usenet sites
Bazarr auto-downloads subtitles — integrates with Sonarr and Radarr
setupSteps: Deploy the *arr stack using docker-compose (Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr)
Configure Prowlarr with your torrent trackers and Usenet indexers
Connect Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr to Prowlarr and your download client (qBittorrent, NZBGet, etc.)
details: The *arr suite is a collection of open-source media automation tools. Sonarr monitors TV shows and automatically downloads new episodes. Radarr does the same for movies. Lidarr handles music, and Readarr manages ebooks. Prowlarr acts as a centralized indexer manager, connecting to 500+ torrent trackers and Usenet indexers, then syncing them to all your *arr apps. Bazarr automatically downloads and syncs subtitles. All apps feature quality profiles, calendar views, automatic failed download handling, and a clean web UI. Run them together via Docker for a complete media management pipeline. Licensed under GPL-3.0.
